summary: בזר means to scatter or disperse people or goods. Its qal and piel uses show spreading things apart, while the unrelated Persian royal name בִּזְּתָא is excluded.

senses.definition: A ruler scatters peoples who delight in battles.
A conqueror scatters plunder, spoil and wealth among his followers.

note: בִּזְּתָא (b.bc.ab), the Persian royal name in Esther, is a proper name and is not a word of the scatter root. Arabic Lane supports scattering seed under بذر.
